periods.label: After the first journey
periods.hint: Early Galatians, if the south-Galatia reading holds.

periods.label: Second journey
periods.hint: Corinth. Acts 18 and Gallio mark the year.

periods.label: Third journey
periods.hint: Ephesus, Macedonia, Corinth again; Romans at the close.

periods.label: Caesarea
periods.hint: Two years in custody (Acts 24–26). No letter is securely placed here.

periods.label: House arrest in Rome
periods.hint: Acts 28. Consensus cluster: Ephesians, Colossians, Philemon, Philippians.

periods.label: After Acts
periods.hint: 1 Timothy, Titus, and 2 Timothy in the usual evangelical reconstruction.

themeGroups.label: Coming
themeGroups.hint: The Lord’s return, grief, and hope.

themeGroups.label: Cross
themeGroups.hint: Justification, the word of the cross, weakness.

themeGroups.label: Christ
themeGroups.hint: Who Jesus is, and life joined to him.

themeGroups.label: Church
themeGroups.hint: Order, household, a people trained by grace.
